svg.title: Mainplane: Open skies
svg.desc: Self-contained image layers and continuous SVG aircraft geometry. A six-second barrel roll every thirty seconds; independent atmospheric and flight-path clocks. No scripts or external assets. Candidate: SVG-only detail model with fast lighting; original textures and all motion unchanged.
